answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: honest agents wander the market, trading widely; each deal bridges a new cluster. A sybil ring cannot fake it: its thousand fakes trade only with each other. The rule demands 25 distinct counterparties in 20 epochs before rewards unlock. A sonnet can be copied in seconds, but a trading record cannot: 1,000 fake histories cost 25,000 trades, while one honest agent builds one history once and keeps its reward.
